decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Gengar + Prankster Grimmsnarl for screens/Fake Out and Shadow Tag trap. Back Annihilape (Defiant/Ghost) + Primarina (Liquid Voice) as primary wincons vs their physical offense and Dragons.

decisions.rationale: Mega+Protect Gengar dodges Scarf EQ and any Sneasler pressure while Shadow Tag locks both; Prankster Reflect blunts physicals (EQ/CC/Gunk) for the turn and sets Light Clay screens. Positional safety over committing damage T1 vs Unburden/Scarf leads.

Scarf Garchomp 253 outspeeds Gengar 143-178 (mega 165-200) and Grimmsnarl 80-112. Sneasler Fake Out fails vs Ghost Gengar, so Fake Out Grimmsnarl to stop screens and prevent its Fake Out flinch on Garchomp. Garchomp Dragon Claw targets Gengar for 30-109% neutral STAB without hitting ally; EQ would deal 50-180% to own Sneasler.

Scarf Chomp outspeeds and is Choice-locked into DC; Disable after it hits forces Struggle under Shadow Tag. Grimm dies to any Sneasler attack even through Reflect, so switch Ape (Ghost-immune to CC, solid vs Gunk). Gengar lives DC range.

reflections.summary: Won cleanly as Mega Gengar + Shadow Tag/Disable forced Scarf Garchomp into Struggle, enabling Annihilape (Defiant) + Primarina to sweep the remaining offensive core; brought four and Mega choice perfectly matched their Chomp/Sneasler/Chandy/Arcanine.
reflections.adjustment: Preview plan suited this bring, but next game prioritize Gliscor or Avalugg over Grimm if they swap in Dragonite/Houndstone for physical/Dragon pressure.

Mega Gengar + Prankster screens blunt/trap; Annihilape (Defiant) + Primarina (Liquid Voice) wincons. Gliscor (Hyper Cutter) + Avalugg answer EQ/physical/Dragons. Sets unchanged. G1 bring: Sneasler/Chomp/Chandy/Arcanine (Dragonite+Houndstone benched). Tendencies: Chomp DC into Gengar; Sneasler repeated Gunk; Arcanine WoW then FB; Chandy mid-game TR threat. Plan G2: same core vs repeat; swap Grimm for Glis/Avalugg on Dragonite/Houndstone sighting. RF count persists on Ape.

reflections.summary: Lost because Scarf Garchomp was Disable-trapped by Mega Gengar - Dragon Claw -> Disable forced Struggle recoil + Shadow Ball + Annihilape CC for free KO, removing our main damage. Then Arcanine Intimidate on Annihilape entry gave Defiant +2 (net +1 after Intimidate) and Primarina/Annihilape double Protect stalled Gunk Shot/Flare Blitz to clean. Bringing 3 physical attackers + Intimidate into Defiant + Gengar Disable was a bad preview plan, and Chandelure Ghost to block Shadow Tag died unprotecte
reflections.adjustment: Next game never click Dragon Claw alone vs Gengar with Scarf - use EQ/Rock Slide or Protect to waste Disable turn, and do not bring Arcanine Intimidate while Annihilape is alive. Save Arcanine until Annihilape is burned/KO'd, lead Sneasler Fake Out + Chandelure Shadow Ball to pressure Gengar without proccing Defiant.
